description: This file defines the AttendanceReport class within the OrangeHRM system, specifically for handling attendance report generation, filtering, validation, and accessibility. It includes methods for preparing filter parameters, validation rules, report header, filter definitions, and data retrieval, and enforces access control based on user roles.

classes.name: AttendanceReport
classes.description: A class responsible for generating, validating, and handling attendance reports within OrangeHRM, including filtering, access control, and report data preparation.

methods.name: prepareFilterParams
methods.description: Prepares filter parameters for the report based on request parameters and user permissions.

methods.name: getValidationRule
methods.description: Provides validation rules for the report filtering parameters.

methods.name: getHeaderDefinition
methods.description: Defines the report header columns, including labels and sizing.

methods.name: getFilterDefinition
methods.description: Returns an empty filter definition object.

methods.name: getData
methods.description: Retrieves the report data based on the given filter parameters.

methods.name: checkReportAccessibility
methods.description: Enforces access control to ensure the user has permission to view the report.
